entries.name: Step-Down to Step-Up — quick grounded reversal
entries.sourceName: Step-Down to Step-Up — quick grounded reversal
entries.instruction: Accept a small controlled lowering then push through the lead foot without flight. Stand with both feet on a low inspected step. Keep the lead foot planted, lower the other heel to a light floor touch in 2 s, then drive back up quickly until both feet join. One complete down-and-up rep per lead leg. Do not bounce from the floor foot. Recovery: complete one leg's bout, rest 45 s, then the other leg; 2 total reps; 90 s before the next exercise/section Use instead: a shallow supported single-leg squat lower-and-rise at the same per-leg dose if the step height or path is unsuitable.
